summary: Each of the 6 document mixes was sent through Recruit's real staging path (document-esign, built-in signing) and its unsigned PDFs were compared with MOSO's render of the same template and the same values. The wording matches in all 11 documents. Update 09/11 afternoon: the address format is fixed on staging (re-run below), the visible signature placeholders have a document-esign PR waiting for its owners, the company Date line turned out to match MOSO's signed PDF, and the slow first request is a gateway limit the portal already retries past.

findings.title: Fixed on staging: the Exclusive Agent address now matches MOSO
findings.detail: Recruit printed 100 Test Way Suite 1, …; MOSO prints 100 Test Way, Suite 1, … (7 of the 8 addresses with a unit, in 171 production MOSO fills). recruit-be #946 (squash 5e72cdd0) joins the second street line with a comma. It is live on staging. Re-run with fresh leads for the c4 and c6 mixes: both Exclusive Agent PDFs now print 100 Test Way, Suite 1, San Jose, CA 95122, and the address no longer shows up as a difference (the two documents below come from that re-run).

findings.title: Open: the Exclusive Agent signature placeholders are visible
findings.detail: The unsigned PDF shows \s1\ on the Agent signature line and \d1\ on its Date line. The 1099, W-2 and CA templates hide the same placeholders. Fix proposed in document-esign #143 (wraps them like the other templates; adds a test). Not merged: the document-esign owners review it. Still visible in the re-run.

findings.title: Open: headings lose their bold and small caps
findings.detail: document-esign prints the agreement titles, RECITALS, the Article headings, NOTICE: and the Exclusive Agent headings in regular weight. The templates already ask for bold, so this is in the renderer's fonts, not the templates. Raised in #143 for the owners; not fixed there. The wording is unchanged.

findings.title: Corrected: the slow first signing-link request is the gateway's 5 second limit
findings.detail: The 503 on the very first request (c1) came from the API gateway in front of recruit-be: its recruit-svc route has a 5 second timeout (lf-homepage logged upstream answered 503 4.9 seconds into the request; recruit-be finished the envelope 2 seconds later). It was not lf-homepage's 10 second limit, so raising that limit would change nothing, and it was not raised. The portal already retries a 503 after 5 seconds (up to 3 tries), so a Loan Officer sees the sign button turn on a few seconds later, with no error message. In the re-run the first request took 2.6 seconds. If it needs fixing, the place is the gateway's timeout for that route.

accepted: The CEO signature image. MOSO's templates carry Thuan Nguyen's signature image on the company lines. document-esign leaves the line blank, with the caption.

The company Date line on the Exclusive Agent Agreement. document-esign prints the agreement date there. MOSO's unsigned PDF leaves it blank, but its form puts the Loan Officer's signing date on that line as well, so MOSO's signed PDF shows a date there too. document-esign chose the agreement date on purpose (documented in the template), so the Inkless date tag is not printed twice. Reclassified: not a finding.
1099 fill_date, text_1, text_2. Blank on both sides (effective date in §1.01 and the notice address). The text comparison finds no difference there.

"LOAN FRAUD - ZERO TOLERANCE" on 1099 and W-2 page 16. The tool lists it as a text difference, but it is not one: MOSO has the heading as an image and document-esign has it as text. The pages show the same heading.
Signature placeholders in the 1099, W-2 and CA renders: invisible on the page, present in the text for the signing step.
Initials, names and "Print Name" placed in a different order in the extracted text: the two renderers lay out the same fields differently. Counted, not listed.
method: Recruit side. 6 staging leads bao.trinh+esign-c1..c6@loanfactory.com (fictional names "Esign Combo One..Six", no MOSO record), each claimed, offer approved with the fee waived, 1-1 marked done, and the combo's portal answers saved (W-2/1099, licensed and sponsor states, DRE, NMLS 9900001, 100 Test Way Suite 1, San Jose CA 95122). One signing-link request each created an envelope on document-esign's built-in path; each envelope held exactly the expected documents. The unsigned renders were downloaded from document-esign (generatedFileId), then the 6 envelopes were cancelled unsigned and the leads archived.

Re-run (09/11 afternoon). After recruit-be #946 reached staging, two fresh leads (bao.trinh+esign-c4b, bao.trinh+esign-c6b, same fictional names and answers) went through the same steps. Their envelopes (b3330dec, eef4d6b4) were collected, cancelled unsigned, and the leads archived. Their Exclusive Agent PDFs replace the first run's on this page; the other 9 documents are from the first run.

MOSO side. MOSO's own HR-agreement path (packs FillPdfFormOp + PdfUtils.fill) downloads the public template PDF and fills its form fields. It was rebuilt offline with PDFBox, using the MOSO values for the same person: legal name, initials, the date document-esign printed (11/08/2026, Pacific), NMLS, and MOSO's address format. MOSO staging's Generate Doc was not used: it fills a loan's context, not a Loan Officer's, and stores the file in that loan's Drive folder. No MOSO, Inkless or e-mail call was made.

Comparison. Text by pdftotext, spacing removed (the two renderers wrap and justify differently), compared character by character; a deletion and an insertion with the same characters count as a move. Pages are shown once per template (the other combinations differ only by the name). Tool: docs/handoff/moso-decouple/esign-compare/compare.py (collect, cancel, moso-fill, compare).
Staging only. Production was not read or written, except read-only counts of the address shape and date shape in MOSO production fills. No value was printed.

exclusive_agent_agreement: Re-run after the address fix: the address matches MOSO. Still open: \s1\/\d1\ visible on the Agent lines (document-esign #143). The company Date line is listed as a text difference but is accepted (see above). Headings are not bold.
